question.text: Any change in valuation methodology shall be construed as:

answer.text: A material change significantly influencing investor decisions

explanation.text: The Logic: Any change in valuation methodology or approach is a material change significantly influencing an investor's decision to continue in the scheme. It therefore requires SEBI disclosure and reporting, plus an annual PPM change disclosure to SEBI and to investors. The Trap: Treating it as non-material or an audit-only matter underplays the investor impact. The Compliance Test Report (submitted within 30 days from financial-year end) separately checks NAV independence and standardized valuation compliance — it is not a quarterly filing. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XIX-B AIF (Cat III) Distributors workbook, pp.137-138 and 141-144.
